package codestructuretype

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// CreateCodeStructureTypeInput holds create payload.
type CreateCodeStructureTypeInput struct {
	Code             string
	Name             string
	Description      *string
	ValidatorService *string
}

// CreateCodeStructureType creates a new structure type.
type CreateCodeStructureType struct {
	Structures repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository
}

// Handle creates and returns created structure type.
func (uc CreateCodeStructureType) Handle(ctx context.Context, in CreateCodeStructureTypeInput) (*domain.CodeStructureType, error) {
	structureType := domain.CodeStructureType{
		ID:               uuid.NewString(),
		Code:             in.Code,
		Name:             in.Name,
		Description:      in.Description,
		ValidatorService: in.ValidatorService,
		CreatedAt:        time.Now().UTC(),
	}
	if err := uc.Structures.Create(ctx, structureType); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return uc.Structures.Get(ctx, structureType.ID)
}
